source_title: WYDOT / Wyoming Highway Patrol Commercial Permits (W.S. 31-18-804)
verify_reasons: Fees confirmed from Wyoming Statute 31-18-804 (oversize $25 + $0.03/foot-mile over 15' wide/15' high/75' long; overweight minimum $40 + per-ton-mile over 80,000 lbs); the exact per-ton-mile rate table is administered by WYDOT — confirm the quote in wydotpermits.wyo.gov.

Escort thresholds differ by road type (Interstate/divided: 1 escort over 14' wide, over 15' formalized; two-lane primary/secondary: 2 escorts over 13'11" or whenever the load crosses centerline; Interstate length escorts at WHP discretion) — confirm per route.
Superloads over 80 tons (160,000 lbs) require a paid WYDOT structural review before permit issuance.

superload_thresholds.note: Beyond routine permit limits (18' wide, 17' high, 110' long); loads over 80 tons (160,000 lbs) GVW require WYDOT state-level structural review, routed and paid before any permit is issued (W.S. 31-18-804).

width.note: Interstate/divided: 1 escort over 14' wide. Two-lane primary/secondary: 2 escorts over 13'11" or whenever the load extends left of centerline (route-dependent)
over 15' wide: escorts on Interstate/divided; two-lane requires 2 escorts

height.note: 1 front escort with height-measuring device over 17' high; escorts below 17' at issuing-authority discretion

length.note: two-lane primary/secondary: escorts over 109-110' overall; Interstate length escorts at WHP discretion

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize single-trip permit = $25, plus $0.03 per foot (or fraction) over 15' wide / 15' high / 75' long, for each mile traveled (W.S. 31-18-804). Overweight single-trip minimum $40 plus a per-ton-mile charge on weight over 80,000 lbs GVW. Superloads over 80 tons require paid structural review first.
single_trip.note: Single-trip/oversize permits usually valid one day or one trip; call the Port/Scale at least 1 hour before arrival for clearance.

annual.note: Annual/90-day permits available for qualifying moves; fees vary — quote via wydotpermits.wyo.gov.

movement_restrictions: Movement may be restricted during adverse weather (high wind, ice, snow, low visibility) per permit
Holiday and metropolitan curfews may apply per permit and route type
notes: Legal length is 60' for a single vehicle/semitrailer-and-load including overhang; width 8'6", height 14'0", GVW 80,000 lbs (higher by axle group).
Overweight fee is per-ton-mile on weight over 80,000 lbs, so a gross-weight-only verdict is indicative — confirm the WYDOT quote.
State-level rules only; county/city permits and bridge-specific engineering out of scope.
